description: Add an audio file to a session from a public https URL (any audio file online; a bounce's pre-signed stem link works as is). Ingested server-side and returned as a sha256 you then use: place it on a track with attach_audio {track_id, blob_sha256}, or load it into a Quick Sampler with load_quick_sampler_sample {track_id, sample_path: "<the sha>"} — it bakes into the downloaded .logicx, no desktop needed (the drum-pack / sample-swap path). A file on the user's machine needs no upload: attach_audio local_path / load_quick_sampler_sample sample_path keep it local (doseedo_edit_ops_reference).

audio_key.description: Instead of audio_url: the key of audio already uploaded to this doseedo account (starts with "ingest/").

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio — any public URL, or a doseedo result URL from a job (pre-signed links work as-is; no key needed).

name: doseedo_add_audio_to_session
title: Add audio to a session
